PlanFact.description: A fact of the plan the print's file does not state.

oneOf.description: The file states no final height.
The file labels no extrusion types.
The file carries no estimate of the time left, by the current position.
The file sets no flow factor, by the current position.
The file sets no part-cooling fan speed, by the current position.

PlannedObject.description: One object the print's file lays down, and the bed area it covers.

name.description: Its name, as the file labels it.

x_mm.description: The least and most X its material reaches, in millimetres.

y_mm.description: The least and most Y its material reaches, in millimetres.

SetValue.description:
One adjustable as the print's file set it at the current position, and as
a change made through this program since then left it.

file.description: What the file's own commands set it to, by the current position.

printobserver.description:
What the latest change made through this program set it to, when one
was made after the file last set it.

description:
What the slicer planned at the print's current file position: the shape
and place of what should be printing, read from the print's own G-code.

These are the slicer's plan rather than an observation: a feature named
here is part of the design at this height, and nothing here says how well
it printed.

fan_percent.description: The part-cooling fan speed, in percent.

final_z_mm.description: The final layer's height, in millimetres.

flow_factor.description: The flow factor, one meaning one hundred percent.

layer.description:
The layer the print is in, counting the first as 1; absent before the
first.

layers.description: How many layers the file plans.

minutes_left.description: The slicer's own estimate of the minutes left, at the current position.

objects.description: Every object the file lays down, each with the bed area it covers.

types.description:
What the current layer lays material as, in the order the file first
names each: `Perimeter`, `Support material`, `Bridge infill`.

unknown.description:
The facts the file does not state, which are therefore unknown rather
than absent.

z_mm.description: The current layer's height, in millimetres.

title: SlicerPlan
